events.title: Bachata Foundations: Master Your Waves
events.description: Want to build stronger basics and finally make your body waves feel smooth, controlled, and effortless? This workshop is all about refining your technique and understanding the mechanics behind clean, fluid waves. During two focused hours, we’ll break down the fundamentals step by step and show you how to naturally integrate waves into your social dancing. Price: 250 SEK per person.

events.title: Bachata Bootcamp w/ Victor & Alba
events.price: 1200 SEK per person / 2300 SEK per couple
description: Join our exclusive Bachata Bootcamp with guest instructors Victor and Alba, straight from Spain — bringing authentic style, technique, and energy to the dance floor.
During two intensive days, you’ll dive deep into technique, partner work, and powerful combinations designed to elevate your dancing.
Expect detailed feedback, dynamic drills, and an inspiring atmosphere that will challenge and motivate you.
What you’ll get: Expert training, stronger technique, deeper connection, and combinations you can confidently use socially.
Open for dedicated dancers who want to push their level and train seriously — while still having fun.

events.title: Discover Bachata Sensual
description: Have you ever felt the music move beneath your skin? Move softly and playfully without any previous experience.
A passionate and modern partner dance focused on connection, musicality, and enjoyment.
Explore the basics, learn fluid movements, and discover how fun and relaxing it is to dance together.
A safe and welcoming introduction providing tools to dance with both your body and your emotions.
No previous experience needed—just curiosity. Come alone or with a partner and let the music guide you.

events.title: Bachata Sensual – Beginner Course
description: Learn the fundamentals of Bachata Sensual in this two-hour beginner course.
No previous experience is required – this course is for anyone who wants to try bachata from the beginning.
Join us on Tuesday, August 4, from 18:30–20:30 in Guldheden, Gothenburg.
Price: 199 SEK.

__MALL_events_SPARA_FOR_SENARE.description: A weekend focused on musicality and advanced partner work. Perfect for level 3+.

__MALL_events_SPARA_FOR_SENARE.title: Bachata Sensual Intermediate/Advanced
description: Designed for experienced dancers who want to sharpen their technique and refine the details that truly elevate their dance.
During three intensive hours, we work on precision, advanced body movement, complex transitions, and dynamic combinations.
Focus on high-level lead & follow responsiveness, waves, isolations, and creative musical interpretation.
Expect challenging combinations for the social dance floor and detailed feedback in an inspiring environment.
For dancers who train regularly and are ready to be challenged. Push your limits. Elevate your dance.
